blocks.text: The purpose of this letter (this "Confirmation") is to confirm the terms and conditions of the Transaction entered into between us on the Trade Date specified below (the "Transaction").
The definitions and provisions contained in Version 1.0 of the Main Book of the {{trade.legal.fxDefinitionsVersion}} (as published by ISDA and EMTA, Inc.) are incorporated into this Confirmation.

variants.With_MCA: This Confirmation constitutes a "Confirmation" as referred to in, and supplements, forms a part of, and is subject to, the ISDA Master Agreement dated as of {{trade.legal.isdaMaster.date}}, as amended from time to time (the "Agreement").
variants.Without_MCA: This Confirmation evidences a complete and binding agreement between you and us as to the terms of the Transaction. Until we execute an ISDA Master Agreement, this Confirmation shall be subject to an agreement in the form of the ISDA 2002 Master Agreement (election of {{trade.legal.governingLaw}} as the governing law and {{trade.legal.terminationCurrency}} as the Termination Currency).
